faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our subscription plans

q1.question: Can I choose different services for each slot in my subscription?
q1.answer: Absolutely! Every subscription plan gives you complete freedom. You can choose any combination of services — a wash for one slot, a dry clean for another, and a polish for the third. It's entirely up to you.

q2.question: How long is my subscription valid?
q2.answer: Each plan has a generous validity period. Starter plans are valid for a flexible duration, Pro plans have an extended period, and Elite plans offer the maximum validity for year-round coverage. Contact us for specific timeframes.

q3.question: Can I upgrade my plan later?
q3.answer: Yes! You can upgrade from a smaller plan to a larger one at any time. We'll adjust the difference accordingly so you don't lose any unused services.

q4.question: Do I need to use all services at once?
q4.answer: Not at all. You can schedule each service individually at different times. Use them whenever it's convenient for you within your plan's validity period.

q5.question: Is BLINK a mobile service?
q5.answer: Yes! We are a fully mobile service. Our professional team comes to your location — whether it's your home, office, or anywhere else — fully equipped with everything needed.

q6.question: What if I need more services than my plan includes?
q6.answer: You can always book additional services separately, or upgrade to a larger plan. We also offer the flexibility to purchase a new subscription alongside an existing one.

The ideal option for daily routines and cars in excellent condition.

polish.title: Paint Polish & Correction
polish.description: Professional paint correction and polishing service that removes scratches, swirl marks, and oxidation to restore your car's original shine and luster.
polish.features: Scratch removal, Swirl mark correction, Paint restoration, Mirror finish

one_stage.title: Stage 1
points: Light treatment in one step.
Restores shine and improves the appearance of the bodywork.
Suitable for new cars or cars in excellent condition.
🎁 Gifts: floor papers,perfumed medal,tissues,steering wheel and gear shifter cover

two_stage.title: Stage 2
points: Stage 1: Correcting scratches and moderate imperfections.
Stage 2: Final polishing and intense shine.
Perfect balance between time and results.

three_stage.title: Stage 3
points: Stage 1: Deep correction of scratches.
Stage 2: Medium polishing to refine the bodywork.
Stage 3: Final polishing with a luxurious glass shine.
Designed for professional results and distinctive cars.
🎁 Gifts: floor papers,perfumed medal,tissues,steering wheel and gear shifter cover

Conclusion.title: Conclusion
Conclusion.description: In short, the more stages of polishing, the more accurate and stronger the result, but at the same time, it requires more time and experience. Choosing the right stage depends on the condition of the car and the result you want to achieve.

nano.title: Nano Ceramic Coating
nano.description: Advanced nano ceramic coating technology that creates a protective layer on your vehicle's paint. Provides excellent hydrophobic properties, UV protection, and chemical resistance.
nano.features: Hydrophobic coating, UV protection, Chemical resistance, Enhanced gloss
points: • Transparent protective layer covering the body.
• Protects against sunlight, dust, and minor scratches.
• Makes washing easier and maintains shine for a long time.
• 🎁 Dry cleane.
• 🎁 Gifts: floor papers,perfumed medal,tissues,steering wheel and gear shifter cover.
Deep shine and continuous daily protection.

graphene.title: Graphene Coating
graphene.description: Revolutionary graphene coating technology offering superior protection and performance. Provides exceptional durability, heat dissipation, and anti-static properties.
graphene.features: Superior durability, Heat dissipation, Anti-static properties, Self-healing technology
points: • Advanced protective layer containing graphene.
• Higher resistance to water and heat.
• Provides a deeper shine that lasts longer than nano-ceramic.
• 🎁 Dry cleane.
• 🎁 Gifts: floor papers,perfumed medal,tissues,steering wheel and gear shifter cover.
Advanced technology... Luxury protection that lasts longer.
